accountability_rule: Exactly one accountable owner writes each boundary. Consumers may adapt through a declared port; they do not become a second authority.

boundaries.consumer_example: A document pins authority/kind/id/revision and can be read after its current value changes.
boundaries.negative_case: A filesystem path, blank identity, or matching name across authorities is not a reference or permission grant.

boundaries.consumer_example: A registered namespace update preserves unknown sibling annotations.
boundaries.negative_case: A duplicate namespace or managed field written as free annotation is rejected/routed to its semantic owner.

boundaries.consumer_example: A candidate or decision document records its exact current/pinned revision and role.
boundaries.negative_case: Unlinking an association does not delete a document and a draft is not automatically a candidate.

boundaries.consumer_example: A command binds an authenticated actor, expected version/revision, edit token and exact request digest to a receipt.
boundaries.negative_case: A changed replay key conflicts; a request digest never grants authority; failed/unknown receipts are not committed.

boundaries.consumer_example: A consumer observes a duplicate, reorder or gap in one authority/stream and recovers by reading durable state.
boundaries.negative_case: A cursor gap does not infer missing facts, readiness, completion or dispatch.

boundaries.consumer_example: A scoped checkout pins actor/session/token/fence/base revision and exact draft/final snapshots.
boundaries.negative_case: Cleanup is not release; unmanaged writers make deletion unsafe; manual and idle finish do not create two finalization identities.

boundaries.consumer_example: A domain explicitly registers its resource/document/namespace/operation/event identities and proof refs.
boundaries.negative_case: Duplicate domain IDs, commands or namespaces fail; a domain does not privately mutate another domain's state.

boundaries.consumer_example: A decision pins candidate, criteria and evidence refs and remains readable after a later decision.
boundaries.negative_case: Selection, assessment, acceptance and publication are not collapsed; changed consumed inputs can make applicability stale/uncertain.

boundaries.consumer_example: A readiness explanation names the missing obligation, owner, exact awaited ref/revision and revisit signal.
boundaries.negative_case: Unknown prerequisites are not reported as ready and a readiness read does not dispatch work.

boundaries.consumer_example: A stable dedupe ID and context cursor make a lost or duplicate delivery recoverable.
boundaries.negative_case: A delivery hint is not handled responsibility and does not select the next action.

boundaries.consumer_example: An adapter reports supported invoke/resume/send/inspect/cancel/wait operations and observed session identity.
boundaries.negative_case: Unsupported operations are explicit; logical agent identity is not replaced by a physical session and Runtime jobs are not re-queued.

boundaries.consumer_example: A resource-only pack entry preserves an unknown string kind and its source/digest without executing it.
boundaries.negative_case: A resource declaration cannot activate SQL, dynamic DDL, a schema registry or a private writer.

boundaries.consumer_example: Astrid consumes the common port through its existing Runtime-backed client/facade while preserving IDs and receipts.
boundaries.negative_case: No local Astrid/Runtime schema, event log, product database or installed-origin claim is created by this baseline.
boundaries.notes: Runtime remains Astrid's current writer until G-OTTO and the later AST transfer/qualification. INT owns cross-product validation in its separate worktree.

boundaries.consumer_example: Existing Astrid creative commands continue to write through Runtime until an explicit qualified cutover.
boundaries.negative_case: FND does not dual-write Runtime state or import Runtime implementation into the neutral kernel.

boundaries.consumer_example: INT later validates installed origin and cross-product behavior through its separately owned worktree.
boundaries.negative_case: FND contract tests are not claimed as INT-02 validation or installed product proof.
